title: Yash's 'Toxic' Trailer Release Date Announced
summary: The makers of Yash's upcoming film 'Toxic' have announced the release date of its trailer. The trailer is set to be released on August 8, and new posters featuring Yash and Kiara Advani have been unveiled.
summary_points: Yash's film 'Toxic' has an announced release date for its trailer.
The trailer will be released on August 8.
New posters featuring Yash and Kiara Advani have been unveiled.
